title: UI polish phases 2-3: interactive mockups (design only)
problem: The table shows too much at once, repeats numbers, wastes width on rival stalls and has no single focus per phase; the visual system is inconsistent.
scope: Interactive mockups of buy, price, reveal, evening and home screens, viewable on a phone
Options where there is a real choice (for example the rival stalls)
Each idea mapped to a problem in REP-014
exclusions: Building the chosen design (a separate plan after the owner picks)

acceptance.text: A phone-viewable interactive page covering 5 screens
Options shown where a choice is needed; every idea linked to a REP-014 problem
